references.text: Rahab asked the spies to spare her family, and they gave her an oath. Verse 17 refers back to this oath as the men now clarify its conditions.
The men repeat the condition that if Rahab reveals their mission, they will be released from the oath they have sworn.
Abraham's servant explains that he will be free from his oath if the woman refuses to go with him, illustrating a similar principle regarding conditions for release from an oath.
Provisions in the Mosaic Law concerning oaths and vows, which form the background for how seriously an oath was regarded in Israel.
The Preacher warns against being careless with oaths and stresses the importance of keeping one's promises, highlighting the seriousness of the oath given by the spies.
Jesus teaches about oaths and the importance of fulfilling what one swears, pointing back to Old Testament practices regarding the making of oaths.
